_readme: INPUT for scripts/refresh-docs.mjs -> docs/under-the-hood/costs.md. Edit this file, then run `npm run docs:refresh`. Never hand-edit costs.md. Every figure below is currently a placeholder: Tastemakers has NO pricing model and NO payment code as of 2026-07-23, and no infrastructure invoice has been read into this config. Anything listed in _verify is shown in the generated doc marked VERIFY so a guess is never presented as fact.

_notes.primaryVariablePerUnit: Main per-use cost: one tag-seed run = 1 Google Places fetch + 1 Claude Haiku call + 1 Voyage embedding batch. Never measured - the pipeline has never run at scale.
_notes.perUserMonthAuth: Supabase Auth. Free tier covers current volume; unknown above it.
_notes.perUserMonthDb: Supabase Postgres storage + egress per user.
_notes.hostingFlatMonth: Railway across 3 deployed services (API, web, marketing). Read the actual invoice.
_notes.planPriceUsd: NO PRICING MODEL EXISTS. No payment code in any repo. The only monetization signal is AdSense, and ADS_ENABLED is false in src/lib/ads.ts.
_notes.paymentPctFee: Standard card-processing rate. Not verified against any processor because none is integrated.
_notes.knownFixedCosts: Apple Developer Program is a real recurring cost (~$99/yr) not modelled here - it is not per-user. Add it if you want total burn rather than unit economics.
